page.text:
version: 1
id: playtest
title: Playtest notes
nav: { icon: flag, count: { status: new } }
source:
  folder: playtest/
  fields:
    status:  { type: enum, values: [new, fixing, fixed] }
    project: { type: string }
    device:  { type: string }
    picture: { type: image }
sections:
  - view: board
    group_by: status
    item:
      title: title
      badges: [project, device]
      image: picture
      time: modified
      actions:
        - { label: Fixed, set: { status: fixed } }
        - label: Ask Claude to fix
          ask:
            session: "{project}"
            prefill: "Fix this playtest note: {title}"
actions:
  - { label: New note, create: { status: new } }

page.title: Bed names cut off at 12 letters
Boat clips through the dock on the left turn
page.body:
Third run, turning left past the dock at about half speed.
The bow goes inside the planks for a moment, then pops
back out. Every time on the left side, never on the right.

page.title: Boat keeps drifting while paused
page.body: The current kept running under the pause screen.

page.title: Calendar skips March the first time it opens
page.body: February, then April. Opening it again shows March.

page.title: Hull tilts the wrong way going downhill
page.body: On the long slope in level 2 the bow lifts instead of dipping.

page.title: Rain level too dark to see the rocks
page.body: Fixed by raising the ambient light in the rain level.

page.title: Reminder email lands in spam on the school laptop
page.body: Only on the school's mail; a home address gets it in the inbox.

page.title: Score covers the pause button on small phones
page.body: At 720 px wide the score's last digit sits on top of the pause button.

page.title: Splash sound plays twice when the boat lands
page.body:
After the waterfall, the splash plays once on landing and again
half a second later.
